# Bayes FC

> Team ratings from the betting market: daily attack, defence, and overall strength ratings for Europe's top football clubs, derived from closing betting-market prices and rebuilt every day.

## Ratings

- [Global cross-league ladder (beta)](https://bayesfc.com/): An experimental cross-league ladder placing every European club on one comparable strength scale, rebuilt daily from betting-market closing prices (beta).
- [League ladders](https://bayesfc.com/leagues.html): Daily attack, defence, and overall strength ratings for every club in Europe's top football leagues, derived from closing betting-market prices and comparable within each league.

## About

- [Methodology](https://bayesfc.com/methodology.html): How Bayes FC turns football betting-market closing prices into daily attack and defence ratings for every club.
- Author: Belkacem (https://belkacem.xyz)
- Cite as: Ratings: Bayes FC (bayesfc.com)
